mckinneyOlive.title: MCKINNEY & OLIVE
mckinneyOlive.content:
McKinney & Olive is a one-of-a-kind landmark office tower designed by world-renowned architect Cesar Pelli, offering world-class architecture, premier office space, and exclusive restaurant and retail in the vibrant, pedestrian-oriented neighborhood of Uptown Dallas. Located at the prime intersection of McKinney Ave. and Olive St., the development is a short walk to Klyde Warren Park and the growing Dallas Arts District.

Adding to this elegant building's striking architecture, McKinney & Olive offers 486,000 square feet of Class A+ office space that includes the latest building innovation and technology. Customers enjoy high-efficiency floor plates, 10-foot ceiling heights with floor-to-ceiling clear glass, state-of-the-art security, destination elevators, and unmatched amenities, including an outdoor terrace, conference center, Canyon Ranch-designed fitness studio, Wi-Fi in all common areas, and the landscaped one-acre Piazza.

theArchitect.title: About The Architect
theArchitect.content:
McKinney & Olive was designed by world-renowned architect Cesar Pelli, Gregg Jones, and Rob Narracci of Pelli Clarke Pelli. The development was Pelli’s first design in Dallas and the first commercial building in Dallas, designed by an internationally acclaimed architect since the 1980s.

Founded in 1977, Pelli Clarke Pelli Architects has earned a reputation for designing buildings that express their clients' core values. They have designed some of the most recognizable and successful projects globally, from the World Financial Center in New York to the Petronas Towers in Malaysia and the International Finance Centre in Hong Kong. They design contemporary, broadly resonant, and optimistic buildings and view architecture as a continually evolving art.

The work of Pelli Clarke Pelli has been internationally recognized with over 100 awards for design excellence, including over 40 design awards from National, Regional and local chapters of the American Institute of Architects (AIA). The late Cesar Pelli was selected as one of the ten most influential living architects by the AIA.

customerService.title: CUSTOMER SERVICE IS OUR PASSION, OUR CULTURE, AND OUR ADVANTAGE
customerService.content: Crescent Real Estate’s management team is committed to providing exceptional customer service. As a result, we have been recognized ten times with the prestigious National Commercial Real Estate Customer Service Award for Excellence, or the “A-List” Award, from CEL & Associates, Inc. The key to our success is our people, relationships, and interactions with our customers. This superior service, quality of assets, attention to detail, and commitment to the customer experience that differentiates Crescent from our peers, giving us a competitive edge and making us the “Best in the Industry.”

contentOne.title:
Be responsible,
think sustainable
contentOne.content:
McKinney & Olive operates at the highest level of efficiency and sustainability. We are focused on providing a green building environment for our customers and demonstrating our commitment as stewards of the environment within the commercial real estate market. Because of this, we are LEED v4 O+M: EB Gold certified, meaning we meet the strict guidelines set forth by the Environmental Protection Agency to achieve Energy Star Ratings as well as those set forth by the U.S. Green Building Council for Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED® ).

Factors such as building automation systems, lighting controls, comprehensive green cleaning, and recycling programs are just a few examples of McKinney & Olive’s sustainability practices that contribute to a significant decrease in the overall energy consumption of the earth's resources by reducing energy use, conserving water, minimizing waste, reducing CO2 emissions, recycling materials and improving indoor quality of property environments.

contentTwo.title: The Bees of McKinney & Olive
contentTwo.content:
McKinney & Olive is partnered with Alvéole, an international urban beekeeping company, to address the declining populations of urban pollinators, honey bees. Alvéole has partnered with more than 500 companies in North America to install beehives on urban properties to create ecological awareness of bees. Alvéole has assigned a beekeeping team manager at McKinney & Olive to provide educational and awareness workshops for customers and other bee-related events for customers, including harvesting honey once a year from honey-comb hives.

McKinney & Olive’s beehives are visible to customers from the conference room windows. Bees are responsible for the pollination of more than 130 varieties of fruits and vegetables around the globe. The honey bees’ daily quest is to bring nectar, pollen, resin, or water to their colony to ensure its development. Honey bees are not motivated to sting. They have one goal, and one goal only: to collect nectar and pollen from flowers within a 3-mile radius of their hive and bring it back to ensure the colony’s development.

contentThree.title: Invested in Our Community
contentThree.content:
McKinney & Olive recognizes the importance of promoting healthy communities in which to live and work. The heart of Crescent Real Estate’s commitment to the community is FACES of Change, a unique adopt-a-school program Crescent Real Estate began in 1997. Through this program, Crescent Real Estate managed properties are partnered with local elementary schools that serve at-risk students and families. FACES of Change partnerships bring Crescent employees, customers, and business partners together to provide volunteer time, monetary donations, and in-kind gifts to partner schools. Since its inception, FACES of Change has established more than 80 successful business-to-school partnerships that have impacted the lives of over 30,000 children nationwide.

To learn more about McKinney & Olive’s FACES of Change partnership with Paul L. Dunbar Learning Center or to volunteer, please contact Tricia Wentz at 469.917.4300 or moinfo@crescent.com.

amenities.content: McKinney & Olive offers 50,000 square feet of ground-level retail and dining, featuring Del Frisco’s Double Eagle Steakhouse, Doc B's Restaurant + Bar, Starbucks Reserve, Roti Modern Mediterranean, Malibu Poke, MIXT, CycleBar, Drybar, and Super All Day coming soon. One of the most notable and unique offerings at McKinney & Olive is the beautiful one-acre piazza designed and landscaped by James Burnett, featuring open outdoor space accented with umbrella-covered tables, water features, lawn games all framed with mature shade trees.  Other amenities including an outdoor terrace, conference center, Canyon Ranch-designed fitness studio, and Wi-Fi in all common areas.

contentOne.title: Conference Center
contentOne.content:
McKinney & Olive’s conference center offers a bright and spacious meeting room with floor-to-ceiling windows and includes the latest business support and technology. It can accommodate many types of gatherings and be configured to meet various needs and capacities. The conference center features two Samsung 85-inch 4K UHD resolution Ultra Smart LED monitors, ElectroVoice in-ceiling speakers, and a second dual microphone system. In addition to the state-of-the-art equipment is high-speed Internet access and presentation tools for visual and audio collaboration.

A galley kitchen is located adjacent to the conference center to provide easy access to food service or catering.

To schedule the conference center, please have your suite representative schedule on Angus.

The conference center rates are:

  • $40 per hour, up to 3 hours
  • $150 for a half-day, 4 hours
  • $300 for a whole day, 8 hours
  • After-hour rates available upon request

contentTwo.title: Outdoor Terrace
contentTwo.content:
The outdoor terrace is available for outdoor meetings and events. Located outside of the 5th-floor lobby, the outdoor terrace is integrated with dual microphones and equipped with the 16 speaker Sonance surround system with dual in-ground subwoofers concealed throughout the landscaping. To reserve the terrace, please contact your company’s suite representative.

The Outdoor Terrace rates are:

  • $250 for a half-day, 4 hours
  • Pricing for more than 4 hours or after-hour rates are available through the management office.

contentThree.title: Fitness Studio
contentThree.content:
McKinney & Olive’s state-of-the-art fitness studio is designed and equipped by Canyon Ranch®, the health and wellness leader. The cutting-edge equipment by TechnoGym includes a complete range of cardio, strength, and functional equipment.

In addition to the use of the facility, the following is included in the membership: a spa-like locker room, private shower rooms, and an array of amenities, including premium Canyon Ranch® products, blow dryers, bottled water, chilled hand towels, and complimentary towel service.

The fitness studio is managed by Trophy Fitness, known for the highest quality personal training and unparalleled customer service. A personal trainer is on-site three days a week and offers weekly fitness classes to members.

The fitness studio is an exclusive amenity for McKinney & Olive Customers and is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Memberships are available for $50 per month, and personal training is available Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m.

For more information or to set up a time to activate your membership, contact Trophy Fitness at bwelborn@trophyfitnessclub.com.

location.contentOne: Located in vibrant Uptown Dallas, McKinney & Olive occupies 3.1 acres in the heart of Uptown Dallas. It sits directly across from The Ritz-Carlton Hotel and Residences, Dallas, near downtown’s Dallas Arts District, Klyde Warren Park, and close to the largest concentration of restaurants, trendsetting retail shops, upscale hotels, and high-end residential developments in DFW.
location.contentTwo: McKinney Avenue and Olive Street provide convenient freeway access with proximity to The Dallas North Tollway, one of Dallas’ primary north-south arterial freeways, and Woodall Rodgers Freeway, which allows quick access to I-35 and I-30 to the west and North Central Expressway and I-45 to the east.
